package: minimatch, through eslint, typescript-eslint, eslint-plugin-import and openapi-typescript
reason: A development tool (the linter and the API type generator) can be slowed by a crafted glob pattern. It never runs in production and no input of ours reaches it. The fix is minimatch 11, a major version that ESLint 9 and its plugins do not accept; npm's only suggested fix installs eslint 4.
